# PlaylistCard

MediaCard for playlists — the cover sits on two offset layers, a stacked "pile of cards" that signals a collection.

`Icyre.PlaylistCard` · Media

## Use

```jsx
<Icyre.PlaylistCard title="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Icyre.PlaylistCard" title="…"></x-import>
```
